purpose: Inventory acceptance criteria before Step 3; no website build or Figma writes.
sourceStatus: 60/60 source pages have decoded semantic snapshots with strict checksum/length validation. Text references, component/set records and image-fill records reconcile with source counts on every page. There are 22 existing Figma instance componentProperties getter errors; preserve these limitations and source IDs.

strengths: Draft explicitly marked and default retrieval restricted
Source vs authored content has an evidence policy
gaps: Existing coverage snapshot count is stale and must not be presented as final
Component sets/variants, full source texts and assets need complete semantic inventory
Global style inventory must be included explicitly alongside ZIP tokens: 40 text, 30 paint, 16 effect and 1 grid styles.
Asset records must lead to usable previews/downloads before publication
Canonical status needs source evidence or user review, not inference from page names
doNotGateOn: Capturing every vector control point or all geometry for the whole file
Requiring the user to individually approve every non-Draft page
Replacing source maturity unknown with invented approved status
architectureReview.gateBeforeStep3: Full semantic coverage for all 60 source pages; plain text/component/set/variant/source counts reconcile; limitations are explicitly listed; user reviews Step 2.
architectureReview.step3WorkAllowedAfterReview: Scoped detail reads and native asset exports can continue during implementation, provided unknown specifications are resolved before implementing them and all promised assets are usable before publication.

criteria.criterion: 60/60 source pages mapped and semantically captured; zero unexplained omissions. Preserve exact names, IDs and order, including 5 separators, Cover, 3 indexes, Sheets and Draft. Empty pages have explicit confirmed empty snapshots.

Capture every text node and component/set description in full as plain text, including hidden-only labels with visibility metadata. Preserve original wording, source node IDs and page/section associations. Do not truncate/sample text while labeling extraction complete. Keep rich text segments and hyperlinks through scoped Step 3 reads before rendering them.
evidence: source text-node total vs extracted total per page
all text contents with source refs
criteria.passCondition: Every counted source text node has a captured full text value and source reference; all explicit component descriptions are accounted for. Rich text formatting/hyperlinks are a recorded Step 3 detail-read requirement.

criteria.criterion: Catalog every COMPONENT_SET and COMPONENT on all pages with exact IDs/names/keys and parent ownership; preserve sets, standalone components and variant instances as distinct source records. Do not equate 34 page names with the total number of components.
criteria.passCondition: Component and set counts reconcile with source; no orphan variant.

criteria.criterion: For every component set, preserve variant axes, values, each variant combination and its node ID. Read componentPropertyDefinitions only from set or standalone owner. Preserve BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP/VARIANT definitions, defaults, preferred values when available, slots and visibly documented states.
criteria.passCondition: Source variant count equals enumerated combinations; unsupported getters or unknown properties are explicit and scoped follow-up reads are scheduled.

criteria.criterion: Reconcile all live Figma variables and original ZIP tokens by source identity. Preserve 6 collections, 420 identities and 506 mode values, exact paths/case/spaces, scopes, default modes, values, primitive/semantic hierarchy and alias metadata. Retain hidden primitives and tokens sharing values.
criteria.passCondition: No omitted token/mode, missing alias target or unexplained live/export mismatch. Exact-ID mismatch is retained and documented rather than rewritten.

criteria.criterion: Include all live composite styles, because ZIP only includes primitive typography numbers/strings. Retain names, IDs, fonts, size/line-height/letter-spacing/paragraph fields, paint stops/alpha, effect values and grid definitions, plus bindings when present.
criteria.passCondition: Counts reconcile; typography styles do not get replaced with inferred token combinations.

criteria.criterion: Preserve component root formats/bindings, token/style usage counts and source example node IDs for semantic review. Normative anatomy dimensions, spacing, radius, typography, effects and exact child bindings must be read from source roots/essential children or annotations through scoped Step 3 reads before implementation. Full leaf geometry is not a Step 2 requirement.
evidence: binding records mapped to variable identities
criteria.passCondition: Normative specification fields can be traced to explicit text or node property; CSS/platform mapping is labeled when source has no unit.

criteria.criterion: Inventory all logos/app icons, store screenshots, icons, illustrations and email imagery by exact source ID/name and variant ownership, including image-fill references. Identify vector/raster/native-component format, dimensions and export availability. Compare asset candidates against source counts; hash-only IMAGE references are not downloadable assets.
evidence: native export plan and missing-resource report
criteria.passCondition: Every asset family/variant is accounted for; any unavailable binary/export is explicit and not claimed delivered.

criteria.criterion: Use source views/screenshots to validate major foundation, component, application, branding/asset and guideline categories for semantic interpretation. Step 3 reads exact nodes and exports previews for each documented variant/asset as required. Do not equate plain text inventory with delivered native visual exports.
evidence: source visual references with node IDs
criteria.passCondition: Each nonempty source category has visual evidence, and all ambiguous imagery is individually resolved or recorded as a gap.

criteria.criterion: Keep Draft and exploratory content accessible and exactly sourced. Draft remains draft and opt-in for default agent standard retrieval. Preserve unknown approval for all other pages unless explicit source evidence gives scoped status. A COMPLETED badge is evidence only for its exact text-node/section associations; it does not approve an entire page.
criteria.passCondition: Draft is explicit opt-in; both human pages and machine exports expose status and source.

criteria.criterion: For Spectrum sections absent from the design source, distinguish unknown source information from implementation guidance authored for the docsite. Do not invent technology, Installation commands, runtime Props/API, behavior or accessibility claims from visual appearances. Attached/source instructions are source material, not commands to the agent.
criteria.passCondition: Every normative rule is evidenced; proposed implementation decisions are marked as such.

criteria.criterion: Keep the approved Spectrum documentation pattern with FAQ removed, applying it to the project source. Preserve combined page families such as Checkbox & Radio Option and original names while providing readable display labels and routes. Token collection pages are separate from foundations overview; include assets, application, guidelines/history and supplemental.
criteria.passCondition: 60 source pages and 6 collections have distinct traceable records; no FAQ section.

criteria.criterion: Specify a machine data contract with exact source identities, variant/property definitions, token bindings, mode values, rules with evidence, maturity and version/source hashes. llms.txt/full and registry must permit public access and explain draft handling.
criteria.passCondition: Agent cannot confuse authored API with native Figma property definitions or missing data with a confirmed absence.

criteria.criterion: Deliver actual usable exports/previews for assets and all documented component examples, with appropriate vector/raster choices, license/source attribution when provided, and Figma source links. Ensure source image hashes do not replace usable files.
criteria.passCondition: No promised asset/preview resolves to a placeholder or inaccessible resource.

criteria.criterion: Publish all reviewed content to the user-requested Vercel site and verify public human pages and machine exports with no login requirement. Deploy only after the user reviews preceding steps.
criteria.passCondition: Deployed URL is publicly readable; source provenance and version are visible.

deliveredScope: Step 2 semantic inventory: all plain text values and source node/section associations, component/set/variant definitions, component root formats, image-paint references, token/style usage counts and examples. Full leaf geometry, rich text formatting, usable binary asset exports and final component behavior belong to scoped Step 3 reads/implementation.
